description: Source code implementing NMEA GPS data parsing functions, including checksum validation, message type identification, and coordinate conversion.

methods.name: hex2int
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string segment to an integer value.

methods.name: str2int
methods.description: Converts a string of digits to an integer.

methods.name: gps_deg_dec
methods.description: Converts degrees in DDM format to decimal degrees.

methods.name: gps_convert_deg_to_dec
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude from degrees to decimal format based on hemisphere indicators.

methods.name: str_till_comma
methods.description: Extracts substring till comma and converts to float.

methods.name: nmea_parse_gpgga
methods.description: Parses GPGGA NMEA message to extract GPS fix data.

methods.name: nmea_parse_gprmc
methods.description: Parses GPRMC NMEA message to extract GPS position and time.

methods.name: nmea_get_message_type
methods.description: Identifies NMEA message type based on content and checksum.

methods.name: gps_location
methods.description: Determines message type and parses GPS data accordingly.
